  5. A weight 75.00%

  6. A weight 100.00%

    A 100.00%, B 0.00%. Weighted contributions 10.00 and 0.00 percentage points; portfolio return 10.00%.

One hypothetical paired period, long-only weights summing to 100%, no costs or flows. This demonstrates weighting, not proof of risk reduction; diversification also depends on joint return behaviour.
